sources.title: E-Government: eVisa
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Djiboutian public E-Government portal identifies ANSIE as a public agency attached to the Presidency and says its administrative information is certified and validated by the relevant administrations. It describes electronic delivery but publishes no nationality eligibility list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: Law No. 40/AN/19/8ème L: conditions for entry and stay of foreigners
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal publishes the 2019 entry-and-stay law. It preserves treaties and special regimes, permits ordinary short-stay visas, and routes eVisa pre-authorisation by the country from which the applicant applies rather than passport nationality.
sources.supportingExcerpt: en provenance des pays où la République de Djibouti ne possède pas de représentations ... système électronique E-Visa.

sources.title: National Tourism Office: entry formalities
sources.officialityEvidence: The official National Tourism Office guide describes embassy/consulate and linked Immigration eVisa channels, without a passport-nationality eligibility or issuance-time schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les visiteurs peuvent obtenir leur visa électronique (eVisa) en soumettant leur demande en ligne.
